answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 5435 Country: Pakistan Title: A guy who had the sexual relation ( Livata ) with a male friend before his legal nikah with a virgin pure muslim girl ; what that nikah was really Valid? Question: A guy who had the sexual relation ( Livata ) with a male friend before his legal nikah with a virgin pure muslim girl ; what that nikah was really Valid? Answer ID: 5435 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 653/605=D) Sodomy is a heinous crime and a major sin. The two men should repent to Allah with true heart, seek His forgiveness and resolve not to repeat it again. The nikah however will be valid. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
